info.title: Momna Backend Foundation API
info.description: Foundation runtime plus CORE-API-01 public /api/v1 Core transport. CORE-API-01 exposes runtime-backed Auth/Session, Account Center/Profile, Lifecycle read and Billing/Entitlement contracts while Core application services remain the source of domain truth. Billing access is derived only from server-verified entitlements.

200.description: Process liveness only; never probes dependencies

503.description: At least one required dependency unavailable, errored or exceeded timeout

post.summary: Start Lifecycle Router or Period Onboarding

put.summary: Submit or change an answer atomically

post.summary: Canonical skip action; existing E17 SKIP action maps here

get.summary: Recover completion result without repeating side effects

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but operation is not permitted or requires recent authentication

NotFound.description: Requested Core state does not exist
